name: viora-aegis
description: Universal defensive security skill for coding agents: threat modelling, secure code review, vulnerability triage with false-positive control, insecure-defaults auditing, supply-chain and agentic-CI review, pre-install auditing of other skills, hardening, secret scanning and CI gating. Ships a deterministic planner so small and fast models can execute the same procedures.

runtime.degradedMode: grep-only using rules/*.json when shell execution is unavailable; missing engines are reported, never silently skipped

smallModelSupport.summary: Do not reason about method. Ask the tool for the procedure, then follow it literally.
guarantees: an ELSE branch for every step that can fail
hard stops stated before the work, not after
a self-check block to tick before answering

modes.name: GUARD
modes.summary: Ambient default: never introduce a vulnerability while doing unrelated work

modes.name: REVIEW
modes.summary: Review a diff, branch or pull request

modes.name: AUDIT
modes.summary: Systematic audit of a whole repository

modes.name: FIX
modes.summary: Patch confirmed findings and prove the fix

modes.name: TRIAGE
modes.summary: Turn leads into defensible findings; kill false positives

modes.name: SKILL-AUDIT
modes.summary: Statically audit another skill, plugin or MCP server before installing it

modes.name: SUPPLY-CHAIN
modes.summary: Dependencies, lockfiles, install scripts, advisories, abandoned upstreams

modes.name: CI-AUDIT
modes.summary: Pipelines where untrusted input can reach a credentialed agent

modes.name: VARIANTS
modes.summary: Find every sibling of a confirmed bug and fix the class

modes.name: CONTEXT
modes.summary: Understand the system before hunting; produces no verdicts

modes.name: TESTS
modes.summary: Turn each finding into a regression test and a detection rule

modes.name: HARDEN
modes.summary: Install the gates: hooks, CI, baseline, headers, dependency policy

modes.name: DESIGN
modes.summary: Threat model a feature before it is built

modes.name: AGENT-SEC
modes.summary: LLM, RAG, MCP, tool-permission and agent-autonomy review

commands.name: plan
commands.summary: Print the deterministic procedure for a mode; with no mode, print the routing questions

commands.name: checklist
commands.summary: Print the tick-box short form of a mode's procedure

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: Detect stack, entry points, risk surfaces and available tooling

commands.name: scan
commands.summary: Scan code for vulnerability patterns and secrets; text/json/sarif/markdown

commands.name: defaults
commands.summary: Audit insecure and fail-open defaults only (DEFAULT rules)

commands.name: skill-audit
commands.summary: Static pre-install audit of a skill, plugin or MCP server

commands.name: ci-audit
commands.summary: Audit CI pipelines for untrusted input reaching credentialed agents

commands.name: deps
commands.summary: Dependency and supply-chain hygiene, optional OSV lookup

commands.name: headers
commands.summary: Check live security headers, cookies and CORS

commands.name: baseline
commands.summary: Freeze current findings so only new issues fail the gate

commands.name: report
commands.summary: Merge result files into one SECURITY_REPORT.md

commands.name: init
commands.summary: Write config, pre-commit hook and CI workflow

attribution.note: No text reproduced. Methodology restated in our own words so this pack stays MIT: false-positive gates, triage maxims, insecure-defaults workflow, variant analysis, supply-chain auditing, agentic-CI auditing, constant-time and zeroization review, property-based testing.
Origin of the SKILL-AUDIT mode: static-only pre-install review, behaviour categories, four-step verdict scale.
Test-first rule authoring with ruleid/ok fixtures, taint mode with declared sanitizers, diff-aware CI scanning.
Confidence discipline and exploitability-over-scariness severity rule.

exitCodes.0: clean, or all findings below the gate
exitCodes.2: execution error or a required engine is unavailable
